title: Bar Salts Watermelon Flavour Concentrate 30ml By Vampire Vape
description: Refresh your palate with Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Watermelon flavour concentrate, encapsulating the clean and crisp taste of fresh watermelon. This 30ml bottle provides a straightforward watermelon flavour, perfect for those who appreciate a subtle and refreshing fruit profile in their DIY e-liquids. This concentrate is an excellent base for vapers who like to mix their own juices, allowing you to control the intensity of the flavour and nicotine content. It’s a versatile choice for creating a custom vape experience that caters to individual preferences. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
